nodes.name: Daily 02:00
nodes.notes: Runs at 02:00 in the n8n instance timezone (set GENERIC_TIMEZONE to the practice timezone in docker-compose). n8n execution pruning itself is configured by EXECUTIONS_DATA_MAX_AGE / EXECUTIONS_DATA_PRUNE env vars.

parameters.query:
delete from booking_queue
where fulfilled_at is not null
  and fulfilled_at < now() - interval '30 days'

nodes.name: Retell: list agents
nodes.notes: Retell's current list endpoint is POST /v2/list-agents (the older GET /list-agents is deprecated). Response: { items: [ { agent_id, agent_name, channel, user_modified_timestamp, ... } ] }.

parameters.subject: ={{ $json.has_diff ? 'ACTION NEEDED: Retell agent config drift (' + $json.diff.length + ')' : 'Retell agent config audit: no drift' }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Weekly Retell agent configuration audit
Checked at: ' + $json.checked_at + '
Live agents: ' + $json.live_count + '
Approved agents: ' + $json.approved_count + ' (' + $json.approved_path + ')

' + ($json.has_diff ? $json.diff.join('
') : 'No differences. Keep this email as evidence.') + '

Full-config diff: run retell/scripts/audit-config.ts.' }}
